data.summary: Kimberly-Clark Corporation (KMB) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: Furthermore, the rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies may intensify our cybersecurity risks.

Also, if we fail to perfect or successfully assert our intellectual property rights (including in response to developments in artificial intelligence technologies), we may be less competitive, which could adversely affect our business, financial results and financial condition.
